requirements.Title: AI Productivity Solutions Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-powered productivity solutions for print, scan, and device management workflows tailored for SMB environments.
requirements.Rationale: To provide best-in-class productivity, automation, and ease of use for SMBs with limited IT resources, differentiating HP from competitors.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI software stack and integration with device firmware and SMB portal.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features for print, scan, and device management are functional, intuitive, and demonstrate measurable productivity improvements in SMB pilot testing.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO (Total Cost of Ownership)
requirements.Description: Design Magellan to deliver HP’s lowest total cost of ownership for SMB color tank printers, including hardware, supplies, and maintenance costs.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a top priority for SMBs and a key market differentiator for HP.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires optimization of ink usage, maintenance cycles, and supply chain efficiencies.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan’s TCO is demonstrably lower than HP’s previous SMB printers and key competitors in 3rd party benchmarks.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Introduce a replaceable maintenance box that can be easily swapped by the customer without requiring a service technician.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs for SMBs with limited IT support, improving customer experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Design and documentation for user replacement, supply chain for spare parts.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by an untrained user in under 5 minutes with no tools; validated in usability tests.

requirements.Title: Consolidated SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Develop a centralized online portal tailored for unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs to manage multiple Magellan printers, monitor status, and access support.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses the need for easy device management in SMBs without dedicated IT, providing a competitive edge.
requirements.Dependencies: Portal software development, integration with device telemetry and support systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal supports account creation, device registration, status monitoring, and basic troubleshooting for at least 10 devices per account.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure that at least 60% of the plastic content in the Magellan printer is from recycled sources, exceeding key competitors.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP’s sustainability goals and provides a strong differentiator in the market.
requirements.Dependencies: Supply chain sourcing of recycled plastics, compliance with environmental standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bill of materials and supplier certifications confirm >60% RCP; validated by 3rd party audit.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Use keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure compatibility with Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents user errors and reduces service issues related to incorrect ink usage.
requirements.Dependencies: Design of bottle and tank interface, supply chain alignment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles only fit compatible tanks; tested with 100% success rate in user trials.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: PHA and MINK
requirements.Description: Enable customer replaceable parts (PHA) and support MINK (maintenance at service center) for out-of-warranty devices, targeting most parts as customer replaceable.
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes downtime and cost for SMBs, aligning with the needs of businesses without IT staff.
requirements.Dependencies: Design for serviceability, documentation, and training materials.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 80% of common failures are addressable via customer replaceable parts or MINK at service center; validated in field trials.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering either 80,000 pages printed or 2 years, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Provides reassurance to SMB customers and aligns with expected usage patterns.
requirements.Dependencies: Warranty terms alignment with legal and support teams.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are clearly communicated on packaging and website; claims process is tested and functional.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU: 25/20 ppm Speed and PDL/PS Support
requirements.Description: The PDL SKU of Magellan must support 25 ppm (black) / 20 ppm (color) print speeds and include PDL/PS (Page Description Language/PostScript) support.
requirements.Rationale: Meets performance expectations for higher-end SMB users and competitive positioning.
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware and firmware design, PDL licensing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print speed and language support validated in independent lab tests; meets or exceeds stated metrics.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU: SMB 2.0 Solutions and Advanced View Portal
requirements.Description: The non-PDL SKU must support SMB 2.0 solutions and provide access to the Advanced View SMB portal.
requirements.Rationale: Offers value-added features for SMBs at a lower price point, broadening market reach.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All features listed as available on launch day; validated in user acceptance testing.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Platform as a Service) Support
requirements.Description: Enable Magellan printers to be compatible with HP’s PaaS offerings, allowing flexible service and billing models for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP’s strategic intent to accelerate PaaS adoption and recurring revenue.
requirements.Dependencies: PaaS backend integration, billing system alignment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer can be enrolled in HP PaaS programs and billing is functional in pilot deployments.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features for device health, usage analytics, and remote diagnostics, supporting both internal HP teams and customer-facing portals.
requirements.Rationale: Enables proactive support, fleet management, and continuous improvement based on real-world usage data.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware development, data privacy compliance, integration with HP cloud.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is reliably collected, securely transmitted, and available for analysis in HP’s backend systems.

requirements.Title: AI-Enhanced Support
requirements.Description: Integrate AI-powered support features into the SMB portal and printer firmware to assist users with troubleshooting and maintenance.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces support burden and enables self-service for SMBs without IT staff.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI support features resolve >70% of common issues without human intervention in pilot tests.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Ensure seamless mobile printing support through the HP App for iOS and Android devices.
requirements.Rationale: Meets modern SMB needs for flexible, on-the-go printing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can print from the HP App to Magellan printers with a success rate >95% in user testing.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification
requirements.Description: Obtain Blue Angel eco-label certification for Magellan printers, where applicable.
requirements.Rationale: Demonstrates environmental responsibility and supports sales in eco-sensitive markets.
requirements.Dependencies: Product design and documentation must meet Blue Angel criteria.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Certification is granted by Blue Angel authority before product launch in target regions.
